title: Usage sender library: batched, retried, idempotent sends in accounts-client and a Python equivalent
description: docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md, 'How apps send usage'. In-memory tally per Account, app, deployment and category; one SQS message about once a minute; retry with the same operation ID; never on the request path. Cached quota check stays a direct signed call. TypeScript in packages/accounts-client, Python package for Python apps.
